improvements.recommendation: Task 2 is undersized (only adds 2 optional params with validation). Consider merging into Task 1 (relations are core to thought chaining) or Task 3 (relations + tactics both extend think tool). Current split creates a thin PR with minimal standalone value.
Task 1 creates __main__.py with inline mcp.run(), Task 4 rewrites it with main() wrapper for entry point. Use final pattern in Task 1 to avoid redundant work.

Return schema evolves across tasks (Task 1: thought_number/session_id/next_needed, Task 2 adds relation/targets, Task 3 adds tactic/guidance/expected_outputs). Make evolution explicit in each spec's Context section so workers know they're extending, not replacing.

Task 3 says 'Add all 19 tactics (from plan lines 102-122)' but META_ANALYSIS has style 'special' while others are divergent/sequential/adversarial/checkpoint. Clarify that style is metadata, not a functional concern - no special handling needed.
